title: UAAP: UE ends 30-game losing streak with win over Adamson

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines— University of the East finally broke through in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament, defeating Adamson, 53-47, at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Saturday. The Red Warriors ended not only a 10-game losing streak this season but also a 30-game skid dating back to Season 87 in 2024. READ: UAAP: UE seeks to translate effort into wins after 0-7 start The last time UE won in the league was in October 2024 when it defeated National University. “What we went through is no joke.
